english.note: Use this when making different systems, standards, or practices the same and unified.
Use this when aligning things means making their format, method, or organization consistent.

examples.english: The school will unify the exam formats for all subjects.
examples.traditional: 學校將各科考試格式統一。
examples.jyutping: hok6 haau6 zoeng1 gok3 fo1 haau2 si3 gaak3 sik1 tung2 jat1

examples.english: The company wants to align the report formats across all departments.
examples.traditional: 公司想統一各部門嘅報表格式。
examples.jyutping: gung1 si1 soeng2 tung2 jat1 gok3 bou6 mun4 ge3 bou3 biu2 gaak3 sik1
